text:
The ultrasound shows normal readings, which makes a structural tendon tear or severe inflammation less likely, suggesting the issue may be mechanical or related to the previous fall. Since the pain radiates to the elbow and involves the wrist, I need to rule out nerve entrapment or referred pain from the cervical spine. Does the pain feel like a "shock" or electric sensation traveling down your arm when you move your neck or shoulder?

speaker: Doctor
text:
The normal cervical MRI rules out referred pain from the neck. Given the history of a fall on an outstretched hand and pain localized to the radial side of the wrist, I suspect a scaphoid fracture or ligament injury that may not show up on standard imaging.
